title: Dashpanels
description: A mod adding modular control panels for redstone control.
body:
Dashpanels

Mod adding control panels for more compact redstone controls

--- ## Content - #### Control Panel - Put modules onto this block by shift right clicking on it without an item in hand and having the modules in your inventory - #### Control Cable - Use this block to connect panels to eachother and has a stripped form - #### Stripped Cable - Connects to the control cable to take redstone inputs or outputs from the panels themselves - #### Cable Stripper - Shift right click control cables or stripped cables to pick them up - Right click control cables to strip them - Right click stripped cables to change their configured module - #### Quite a few cool modules for controlling redstone --- ## Compatibility - #### [Computercraft](https://github.com/BoxxedDev/control-panels/wiki/ComputerCraft-Integration) - Control Panel can be a peripheral - #### Create - Adds a new exclusive block for easier link connections - #### Sable - Control Panels can be used aboard sublevels - #### [Dye Depot](https://modrinth.com/mod/dye-depot) - Bulbs can be dyed to extra dyes added by dye depot (or any other dye mod) --- #### Logo made by [JWX](https://www.artstation.com/jwx0001)
